title: Life sciences & healthcare
summary: Controlled air quality for hospitals, laboratories and pharmaceutical zones.
paragraphs: In healthcare and life sciences, filtration reduces infection and contamination risk. Operating theatres, isolation rooms and labs need defined filter classes, air-change rates and traceable maintenance records.
HEPA solutions, sealed housings and planned filter change-outs support compliance and patient safety. BasicAir supports facilities with guidance on filters and ventilation system maintenance.
